verdicts.one_liner: Heal cut and a slower escape on a falling hero — commit to pure gun or fall behind.
verdicts.direct: Card Trick heal 60→45 removes the self-sustain that kept her alive through dives, and Project Mind 46s→50s with a 0.75s→1s cast makes her one escape slower on both ends.
verdicts.indirect: Spirit Lifesteal 13%→15% plus +2 spirit is a real lift to her sustain-gun variant exactly as the patch's anti-heal theme (Decay, Toxic Bullets, stacking Healbane) devalues in-kit healing — the item, not the ability, is now her sustain.
build_adjustments: Drop the on-hit spirit package; build the pure fire-rate gun line (Rapid Rounds, Swift Striker, Ricochet).
Buy Spirit Lifesteal as your sustain slot instead of leaning on Card Trick.
Do not burn Project Mind to rotate — at 50s it is your only answer to a dive.

verdicts.one_liner: Got his invis-engage back and a real Last Stand spike; the slower meta finally fits him.
verdicts.direct: Flask travel +40% and shred -25%→-30% make his poke land and stick, Willpower +15%→+20% speeds the walk-up to the cage, and Last Stand T2 +40.5→+50 DPS with -40s cooldown is a genuine mid-game spike.
verdicts.indirect: Steam Vents losing invisibility hands Shadow Weave back its exclusivity as the only invis-engage, and the comeback package (30% gold, faster Haunted Souls from behind) plus longer games give a late gun scaler the clock he never got.
build_adjustments: Rekey Shadow Weave as a core in the cage-bruiser line — and plan the 6s stealthed buildup before you engage.
Upgrade off base High-Velocity Rounds early; velocity 60%→45% trims his poke.
Take Last Stand T2 first for the -40s cooldown and DPS spike.
